map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(price - dep, price × 0: Core formulas (by input variables): max(price - dep, price × 0.05); max(price - dep, salvageVal); (1 - residual ÷ price) × 100
map.前5年分别折旧 15%、12%、10%、8%、6%（合计51%），5年后每年约折: In the first 5 years depreciation is 15%, 12%, 10%, 8%, 6% respectively (total 51%); after year 5 about 5% per year. Commonly used for quick valuation of family cars.
map.每年折旧额 = (原值 − 残值) ÷ 折旧年限，折旧均匀，适合平稳估值。: Annual depreciation = (original value − residual) ÷ depreciation period; depreciation is even, suitable for stable valuation.
map.年折旧率 = 2 ÷ 折旧年限，前期折旧快、后期慢，更接近新车实际贬值曲线。: Annual depreciation rate = 2 ÷ depreciation period; faster early and slower later, closer to the real depreciation curve of a new car.
map.估值仅供参考，实际成交价受车况、里程、品牌、地区市场等多因素影响。: The estimate is for reference only; the actual transaction price is affected by many factors such as vehicle condition, mileage, brand, and regional market.

map.以「购车价 20 万、车龄 5 年、选 54321 阶梯折旧」为例: Example: "purchase price 200,000 CNY, age 5 years, 54321 step-down depreciation"
map.前 5 年折旧率分别为 15%/12%/10%/8%/6%，累计 51%；第 6: First 5 years depreciation rates are 15%/12%/10%/8%/6% respectively, cumulative 51%; from year 6 about 5% per year, with residual not below the 5% floor of the original value. Cumulative depreciation = 200,000 × 51% = 102,000, estimated residual = 200,000 − 102,000 = 98,000, cumulative depreciation rate 51%. If the age is only 3.5 years: first 3 years 37% + year 4 8% × 0.5 = 4% → cumulative 41%, residual about 118,000. If double declining balance is chosen (life 10 years, annual rate 20%): depreciation is faster early, early residual is lower but flattens later.
map.经验口诀「第1年15%、第2年12%、第3年10%、第4年8%、第5年6%」，合: Rule of thumb: "year 1 15%, year 2 12%, year 3 10%, year 4 8%, year 5 6%", total 51%, then about 5% per year; it reflects the real depreciation curve that is high early and low later, closer to the actual family car than the straight-line method. Residual is set at a 5% floor of original value to prevent zeroing.
map.双倍余额递减和直线法差在哪？: How does double declining balance differ from straight-line?
map.直线法每年折旧额固定（(原值-残值)/寿命），早期残值高；双倍余额递减前期折旧快: Straight-line fixes the annual depreciation ((original − residual)/life), with higher early residual; double declining balance depreciates faster early (annual rate = 2/life) and switches to straight-line later, favoring accelerated depreciation scenarios (e.g. corporate tax). The tool gives three results; choose by use case.
